name: omp-config
description: Settings of the omp-config extensions; the extensions themselves load from config.yml and the extensions directory.

omomp-lang.language.description: Language of person-facing text; exported as OMOMP_LANG at the next OMP start unless the launch environment sets it

lang-nag.language.description: Language the main agent's replies are checked against

lang-nag.instruction.description: Reminder sent when a reply is not in lang-nag.language

input-polish.key.description: Shortcut that rewrites the input draft (next OMP start)

input-polish.instruction.default: 在不改变原意的前提下，改写到听起来会让人更加想努力、能激动人心，但不要太夸张。

tool-policy-nag.detector.description: heuristic: count built-in-tool operations in shell calls; jev: ask the judge about each watched call

tool-policy-nag.form.prompt.default: 你为什么不遵守system prompt，反思自己以后继续。
tool-policy-nag.form.prompt.description: Reminder the heuristic lane (and the jev fallback) sends

tool-policy-nag.form.afterHits.description: Violations recorded silently before the first reminder

tool-policy-nag.form.maxNags.description: Reminders per context before the lane goes quiet

tool-policy-nag.intent.threshold.description: jev: probability at which a judged violation counts

tool-policy-nag.risk.enabled.description: Flag shell calls whose outcome cannot be read off their result

tool-policy-nag.risk.minCommands.description: Untraced chains: commands needed to flag

tool-policy-nag.risk.minChars.description: Untraced chains: characters needed to flag

tool-policy-nag.risk.minPrograms.description: Untraced chains: distinct programs needed to flag

tool-policy-nag.pty.enabled.description: Refuse bash and eval calls that belong in an exec_command PTY session

child-memory-warning.thresholdGiB.description: Resident memory of one child process that raises an alert

omp-config-autoupdate.enabled.description: Apply the GitHub release branch at OMP start (next start)

omp-config-autoupdate.conflicts.description: notify: report conflicts at start; agent: also start the adaptation after an update

omp-config-autoupdate.exclude.description: Whitespace-separated items the updater never writes: agent-dir paths or globs, or config.yml:<dotted.path>

subagent-usage.enabled.description: Consent to read this machine's session transcripts for subagent_usage; machine-wide only
